review.gallery: Seven developer design renders extracted at native resolution from Evelyn’s Nshama brochure. DLD project 4150, album 2239, is dated 26 June 2026 by Dubai Handover. Both originals have identical hashes in Rosewell’s separate project 4149 album. One image is included as a shared site view with the specific plot boundary unconfirmed.
review.location: Nshama’s brochure page 7 identifies Evelyn in the master plan. The page 5 time figures apply to Town Square. Dubai Handover’s named DLD project point agrees with the project sector in the Nshama plan and near the separately published Continental coordinates. The less precise community link on Continental was not used.
review.floorPlans: All six complete sheets of the official standalone layout PDF. Printed built-up totals and min/max ranges visually checked. Small rounding differences in the printed components are retained through the published totals. The brochure’s duplex mention is not backed by an identifiable duplex drawing in the developer plan set.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, current building or interior photography, and a complete project-specific duplex drawing.
